reason: My partner and I already live in WhatsApp and the Sheet, and they cost us nothing. Losing track of a client reply was annoying, but I'd fix that with a column in the Sheet before I'd move both of us into a new app and pay $20 a month for it.
objection: Getting my partner to stop using WhatsApp and actually open another app every day. If only one of us uses it, it's worse than what we have now, and Slack's free plan already covers our chat if we wanted to switch.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged into the WhatsApp chat we already use, so a client message could become a shared task with who's replying, without either of us leaving WhatsApp.
